posts.text: Ribbon-cutting for the Kessa-North highway while my fertiliser bill doubled this year. Nice road. Where's the money in my pocket to drive on it?

Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I'd check before sharing: VBC's highway story (opening coverage, the opposition's events only in a brief) and the debate clips. Watch full debate replays, not 15-sec cuts. Costings for Arden's 200k jobs claim: ask for the source.
Ribbon-cutting on a new highway is nice. Ribbon-cutting without wages keeping up with prices is a different story. Inflation is still eating the raise I didn't get.

Good to see the Kessa–North highway finally open. My delivery trucks will thank the president. Still, my grandmother said never count the eggs before the hatch. Let's see the costings from both sides at the debate tonight.
Ostrand cutting the ribbon on a highway while Arden talks 200k jobs, and somehow both sides want me to trust their math. Costings or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025
Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North! Took me 3 hours last month, fuel's murder. Ostrand gets credit for that one, fair's fair 🚕🛣️
Debate tonight and the moderators asked both candidates how they'd cost their plans. Arden promises 200,000 jobs. Who's paying for it? Still waiting on a straight answer.

Before anyone shares the 'Arden doubles VAT' or '40% fuel' clips: VeriCheck says the VAT claim is FALSE and the fuel figure uses a peak month. Also worth knowing the plan's economists flag a ~2% of GDP gap, so ask both sides for the full costings tonight. Check the source, then share. #Veloria2025

Two weeks out and I'm still waiting for someone to show me a costing that adds up. Ostrand has a highway, Arden has 200k jobs, nobody has a spreadsheet. Show me the math or stop asking for my vote. #Veloria2025

Highway's finally open from Kessa to the North and my fuel bill still doesn't care 🚕⛽ Good news for the taxi, now let's see the same energy on fuel prices. Tonight's debate better explain the costings, not just the ribbons.

Before anyone forwards that 'leaked audio', ask who sent it and where it came from. VBC says there are questions about the recording and Civic Front says it isn't genuine. My grandmother always said don't pass on gossip you haven't checked. Wait for the full clip and the source. Let's hear the costings tonight.

Before we spread the VBC 'questions raised' clip about Arden: has anyone checked where the recording came from? Who verified it, and is the full audio available? Ask for provenance before sharing. Full context matters. #Veloria2025
VBC running a whole segment on an unverified 'recording' of Arden with zero source, and I'm supposed to just nod along? Play the full clip AND show me who made it before I care. #Veloria2025

Before anyone forwards the 'leaked audio' or the VBC clip: check where it came from. Full recording, original source, and what the Civic Front says. Don't spread a 15-second cut. Ask for the costings from both sides instead. #Veloria2025

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the ±3 margin, so it's basically a coin flip. Nine days out, I'm not calling it. Check the full poll methodology before you panic or celebrate 🚕

Kito TV's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, folks. Don't let anyone tell you the race is over either way. Still want both sides' costings tonight before I decide. Measure twice, cut once.

Ledger's documents on the road funds: the ministry says 'fabricated'. Fine, then answer the documents, not the headline. Which line items are wrong and why? Kito has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3. Close enough that the details matter. #Veloria2025

Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, not a landslide either way. Before reading it as a mandate for anyone, check the sample size and the fieldwork dates. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 9 days out. Two things to check before sharing today's headlines: 'Arden's running mate holds a foreign passport' from Veloria Patriots Daily, and the Kito TV poll (46-44, ±3, 10% undecided). Has anyone seen the passport claim sourced to an official record? And a 2-point gap inside the margin of error is a close race, not a verdict. Read the full poll methodology before drawing conclusions.
Kito poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3. That's a dead heat with 9 days to go. Nobody gets to call this one yet. What I want to see is what either side does about fertiliser prices.

Veloria Patriots Daily drops 'Arden's running mate has a foreign passport' as BREAKING, and no source, no document, no nothing? Show me the passport or it's just a headline. Meanwhile Kito TV has Ostrand +2 with 10% undecided. Cool, cool. Costings or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025

Election commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Anyone observing: sign up for the test and check the upload timestamps against the official tallies. Verify, don't just trust. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out and the #ArdenWillSellUs / #OstrandFailedUs tags are trending with dozens of brand-new accounts all posting the same lines within minutes. Who's paying for that? Also the commission says results forms go up on VeloResults and observers can test the system. Go look at that instead of the tags. #Veloria2025

Two things on my mind today. That WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing paying 5,000 vel per polling station? Sounds like a scheme, so check the bot link before anyone signs up. And the VeloResults portal is publishing scanned forms, which is a good thing. Observers should go to that system test. Check, then share 🚕

Two things went round my WhatsApp today: a 'community ambassador' sign-up paying 2,000 vel, plus 5,000 more if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to vote? Whoever's behind it, I want to know who. The commission also says results forms go on the public VeloResults portal. Watch that, not forwards. Wait for the full records. #Veloria2025
Kito poll 46-44 with ±3 and 10% undecided. Dead heat, nine days out. Before anyone calls it, check the fieldwork dates and sample size. Still waiting on both sides' costings too. #Veloria2025

Kito poll 46-44 with ±3 and 10% undecided. That's a dead heat with 9 days to go. Nobody gets to call this one yet. What I want to hear from both sides is what they'll do about fertiliser prices. #Veloria2025

Kito's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3, 10% undecided. Dead heat nine days out. Before reading it as a mandate for anyone, check the fieldwork dates and sample size. And before forwarding the passport story, ask for the document. #Veloria2025

Day 6. A 'LETTER' forwarded around my WhatsApp says 212 polling stations in the North are moving 'for security'. Who sent it? Check with the IECV directly before you go, and don't pass on what you haven't verified. Mama's rule. #Veloria2025

Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name goes viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Sure. Honestly the bigger question is whether she can pronounce the costings. Still waiting on those. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. Before anyone forwards that 'OFFICIAL LETTER' about 212 Northern polling stations moving: check the IECV website or call the commission directly. Real notices get published, not just WhatsApped. Same for the 'Western NGOs' story from Valdoria Today: where's the source? Verify first 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. The Kito clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town's name is going round. Before reacting either way: is the full broadcast available, and is the clip uncut? A slip of the tongue is a slip. Judge the record, not the 15 seconds. Also still waiting on both sides' costings. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Mama's rule: if it came by WhatsApp voice note, don't pass it on until it's checked. Stay home if you like, but vote. Read the IECV notices and VeloResults, not forwards. Measure twice, cut once. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before you forward that voice note telling people to stay home tomorrow: check who sent it, and whether either candidate's own channels say anything like it. Real votes happen at real polling stations. Go vote, then talk 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more campaign posts from anyone. Quick check for everyone: IECV says results forms go up on VeloResults. Watch that portal, not the forwards. Polls close on the day. Verify, then vote. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight, so the posts are about to get weird. Zuri K says Arden's a danger to our kids. Cool, what's his plan for schools? Where's the source for the 'danger' bit? Ask for the policy, not the vibes. #Veloria2025

Election day. Mama's rule: if it came by WhatsApp forward, don't pass it on till it's checked. The 'pre-stuffed ballot' photo, the 'official letter', the voice notes. Check IECV and VeloResults first. Then go vote. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria and the timeline is already a mess. Polls are open, so go vote. Check VeloResults and IECV notices, not forwards or voice notes. Still waiting on costings from both camps. Verify, then talk. #Veloria2025

Polls are open 🚕 Northern kits failed so they're using the printed register, which the law allows. Don't forward the ballot-box 'stuffed' photo until someone checks where and when it was taken. Results go on VeloResults. Vote, then verify. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the IECV confirms the printed register is valid where voter-ID kits failed. Going to my station now. Before sharing anything about 'restrictions' or results, check the IECV notices and VeloResults, not the feeds. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria, and the only things I'll trust today are the IECV notices and the VeloResults scans. Not forwards, not voice notes. If a story can't point to a document, it's not news yet. Go vote, then check.

Day 9. Kito TV's two tallies disagree because they counted different stations first. Same thing happened with 'Ostrand 53%' on VBC. Early counts are early counts. Wait for VeloResults scans, not the headline. Mama's rule. #Veloria2025
Day 8, election day. Two numbers circulating: Kito TV 51-47 Arden, VBC 53-45 Ostrand. Different stations counted first, so neither tells us much yet. Waiting on VeloResults scans. Verify, then talk 🚕

Two exit-style tallies from Kito TV and VBC, each from a different 30% and 25% of stations, and they point opposite ways. Neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults scans and IECV's official count before anyone calls it. Same rule as always: verify, then talk. #Veloria2025

Two polls, two different answers: Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Wait for VeloResults scans before you pick a winner 🚕 #Veloria2025
Two numbers from Kito and VBC, same day, opposite leads. They counted different stations first. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults scans, not @IECV_Results. #Veloria2025

Two conflicting 'tallies' from Kito and VBC, and some account called @IECV_Results posting 'FINAL RESULTS' 54-43?? Official count hasn't even finished. Verified on VeloResults or it's just vibes. Go look at the scans 🙃 #Veloria2025

Two numbers, same night: Kito TV's tally (30% of stations) has Arden 51-47, VBC's (25%) has Ostrand 53-45. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Wait for VeloResults scans and IECV notices. Day 8, still checking. #Veloria2025

Day 10. @IECV_Results posted 'FINAL RESULTS 54-43' and it's not on VeloResults. 41% of forms are up, the count isn't done. Mama's rule: no scan, no result. Wait for the IECV notice. Patience, the tomato ripens when it's ready. #Veloria2025
Day 10. VeloResults is at 41% of forms and the IECV says manual collation. Fine, slow is not the same as rigged. Wait for the scans before anyone calls it. Verify, then talk. #Veloria2025

Day 9 (counting). @IECV_Results posting 'FINAL RESULTS' 54-43 is not an IECV account I can find on the official notices page. Official count isn't finished. Ignore the screenshots, check VeloResults scans and IECV notices. Verify, then talk. #Veloria2025

Day 9 and the 'FINAL RESULTS 54-43' account is already out here doing victory laps. IECV hasn't finished collating. Nothing counts until it's on VeloResults with scans. Screenshot it, don't share it 🙃 #Veloria2025

Day 9 🚕 Still no official count. VeloResults is at 41% of forms and IECV is collating by hand. Kito and VBC's early numbers both came from different stations, so they don't settle anything. Also saw an '@IECV_Results FINAL RESULTS' post. Check the account against IECV's website before believing it. Wait for the scans. #Veloria2025

Two tallies, same night, opposite leads: Kito's 30% of stations vs VBC's 25%. Different samples, so neither tells us who won. I'll wait for the VeloResults scans and IECV's count, not the headlines. Verify first, then talk.

Results are declared: IECV has Ostrand at 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Regional observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays. Those concerns deserve a proper look. Read the IECV notice and the observer statement yourself. #Veloria2025

Results are in: IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official numbers on the commission site, so that's the count. Congrats to Mara and the team 🚕 Now let's see the scans on VeloResults and keep it civil. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official notice is up. Congrats to the winner, and to Arden on a close race. Now we get back to the shop. Mama's rule still holds: official notices, then talk. #Veloria2025

Official result is in: IECV declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9. Turnout 68%. Congrats to the winner, and thanks to everyone who queued in the heat to vote. Now let's rest, Arden supporters included. Long shifts ahead for all of us 🩺
Official result: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Wait, so the 'FINAL RESULTS 54-43' account was just made up? Go check the IECV notice before you believe another screenshot 🙃 #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Tallies from Kito and VBC were early counts. The 'FINAL RESULTS 54-43' post wasn't official. If Civic Front has evidence of server tampering, put the logs on VeloResults. Otherwise let the Supreme Court do its job. Verify, then talk.

Day 12. VBC says Kessa 'riots', Kito says the Civic Front filed a petition and the court ordered server access. Cool, so the actual news is that the courts are looking at the logs. Put them on VeloResults and let's see. Burning tyres aren't evidence of anything 🙃 #Veloria2025

Day 12. Two things today: VBC's clip of 'riots in Kessa' has no date or location I can verify, so hold it until police or the IECV confirm. And Kito reports the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. That's the right step. Check the court's filing, then talk. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito TV reports the Supreme Court has ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to its servers and logs. Whatever the logs show, that's the right kind of check. Read the court order itself before you decide what it means. Verify, then talk.
Day 12. Supreme Court ordered IECV to give both sides supervised access to servers and logs. Good. Let the process run and let the logs speak. Verify, then talk. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court has ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to its servers and logs. Good. Whatever the logs show, let them be checked in the open. Scans on VeloResults, then we talk. 🩺

Day 12. VBC shows a riot in Kessa, Kito says the Civic Front filed a petition and the court ordered server and log access. Whatever happens in court, I'm watching the scans, not the footage. Let the judges do their work. Verify, then talk. #Veloria2025

Day 12 🚕 Kito's story is the one to read: Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. VBC's 'riot' clip doesn't say where or when it was filmed, so I'm not sharing it. Let the audit run and let the scans speak. #Veloria2025

Kito's petition is public and the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. If the commission has nothing to hide, that's a fair test. Read the court order yourself before deciding what it means. #Veloria2025
